existing-109.name: Forearm Plank
existing-109.setup: bodyweight on a dark grey exercise mat, no other equipment

existing-109.p2: full forearm plank: knees lifted off the mat, weight on the forearms and toes, body in one straight rigid line from heels through hips to head, hips neither sagging nor piked, eyes looking down at the mat
existing-109.primary: rectus abdominis (front abdominal wall) and latissimus dorsi (side of the upper back)
existing-109.secondary: obliques (sides of the waist) and transverse abdominis
existing-109.extra: Keep the camera showing her torso clearly from the side, her feminine chest and waist visible through the blue top.

existing-016.name: Floor Glute Bridge

existing-016.p2: hips driven up high so the body forms one straight line from shoulders through hips to knees, shoulders and feet still on the mat, glutes squeezed
existing-016.secondary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and hamstrings (back of thighs)

Colour ONLY the buttocks solid red; the back of the thighs (hamstrings) and front of the thighs (quadriceps) are the lighter orange, not red.

existing-106.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
existing-106.setup: bodyweight, kneeling on the padded kneeling pad of a Nordic hamstring bench, both ankles hooked and locked under the bench's padded ankle roller behind her
existing-106.p1: kneeling tall and upright, body in a straight line from knees through hips to head, hips fully extended, arms relaxed at her sides
existing-106.p2: slowly lowered forward under control to about 45 degrees from the floor, body still one straight line from knees to head (hips NOT bent), arms reaching forward with hands open ready to catch herself

existing-002.name: Bodyweight Squat
existing-002.setup: bodyweight, standing on the floor, feet shoulder-width apart, no equipment
existing-002.p1: standing tall, legs straight, both arms extended straight forward at shoulder height for balance
existing-002.p2: deep squat with thighs parallel to the floor, hips pushed back, heels flat on the floor, chest up, arms still extended straight forward at shoulder height
existing-002.primary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and gluteus maximus (buttocks)
existing-002.secondary: adductor magnus (inner thighs) and soleus (lower calves)

new-051.name: Jump Squat
new-051.setup: bodyweight, on the floor, no equipment
new-051.p1: loaded in a squat with thighs about parallel to the floor, hips back, heels down, arms swung back behind her hips
new-051.p2: exploding straight up into the air: body fully extended in a straight vertical line, both feet clearly OFF the floor with a visible gap of air between her trainers and the floor (draw her shadow on the floor below her), toes pointed, arms straight down by her sides and slightly behind her (NOT raised overhead)
new-051.primary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and gluteus maximus (buttocks)
new-051.secondary: hamstrings (back of thighs) and adductor magnus (inner thighs)
new-051.extra: The arrow sits centred in the gap between the two panels; nothing from one panel crosses into the other.

gap-n004.name: Basic Two-Foot Bounce (ankle hops in place)
gap-n004.setup: bodyweight, on the floor, no equipment, feet together hip-width, arms relaxed and slightly bent at her sides
gap-n004.p1: ground contact: both feet on the floor on the balls of the feet, knees slightly bent absorbing the landing, arms slightly back
gap-n004.p2: high in the air at the top of the hop: her trainers are a FULL FOOT-LENGTH above the floor with a large empty gap down to her shadow, toes pointed down, legs straight, arms slightly forward - she is unmistakably airborne and much higher in the panel than in panel 1
gap-n004.primary: calves (gastrocnemius and soleus) and quadriceps (front of thighs)

existing-012.name: Inverted Row
existing-012.setup: bodyweight, hanging under a horizontal bar on a free-standing metal bar frame at about hip height, overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, heels on the floor, body held straight like a plank
existing-012.p1: hanging under the bar with arms fully straight, body in one straight line from heels to head, chest well below the bar
existing-012.p2: chest pulled up to touch the bar, elbows driven back, shoulder blades squeezed together, body still straight from heels to head
existing-012.primary: latissimus dorsi and middle/lower trapezius (upper and mid back)
existing-012.secondary: posterior deltoid (rear shoulder) and teres major
existing-012.extra: Keep her feminine chest and waist visible through the blue top.

existing-111.name: Box Jump
existing-111.setup: bodyweight, standing on the floor just in front of a wooden plyometric jump box about knee height
existing-111.p1: on the floor in front of the box, in a quarter squat, hips back, arms swung back behind her ready to jump
existing-111.p2: landed softly on top of the box with BOTH feet fully on the box top, knees bent in a soft squat, arms forward
existing-111.primary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and gluteus maximus (buttocks)
existing-111.secondary: hamstrings (back of thighs) and hip flexors (front of hips)

new-069.name: Assisted Pistol Squat (holding a pole)
new-069.setup: bodyweight, standing next to a simple single vertical metal support pole fixed to the floor with a flat base plate (the whole pole from base to top inside the frame), holding it with one hand for balance
new-069.p1: standing tall on her left leg, holding the pole, right leg lifted slightly straight out in front just off the floor
new-069.p2: FULL-DEPTH pistol squat on the left leg: hips dropped all the way down so the back of the left thigh rests on the left calf and the buttocks are just above the left heel, left heel flat on the floor, torso leaning forward, right leg held straight out in front parallel to the floor with the right foot clearly OFF the floor, still holding the rack upright
new-069.primary: quadriceps (front of thigh) and gluteus maximus (buttock) of the squatting leg
new-069.secondary: adductor magnus (inner thigh) and soleus (lower calf) of the squatting leg

Colour muscles ONLY on the squatting left leg (red front of thigh and buttock, orange inner thigh and lower calf); the raised right leg has NO colour at all. Panel 2 must be a full-depth pistol: hips lower than the knee, buttocks near the heel.

new-021.name: Cossack Squat
new-021.setup: bodyweight, very wide stance with feet about twice shoulder width, toes turned slightly out, hands clasped in front of the chest
new-021.p1: standing tall in the wide stance, both legs straight
new-021.p2: shifted sideways into a deep squat over the right leg (right knee fully bent, right heel flat, hips low) while the left leg is completely straight out to the side with the left heel on the floor and left toes pointing up to the ceiling
new-021.primary: quadriceps (front of thigh) and gluteus maximus (buttock) of the bent leg
new-021.secondary: adductor magnus (inner thigh of the straight leg) and soleus (lower calf)

new-016.name: Chest-supported Dumbbell Row
new-016.setup: lying chest-down on an adjustable bench set to about a 30-45 degree incline, feet on the floor, a dumbbell in each hand
new-016.p1: arms hanging straight down toward the floor below the bench, dumbbells near the floor, palms facing each other
new-016.p2: both dumbbells rowed up to the sides of the lower ribs, elbows driven up and back past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed, chest still on the pad
new-016.primary: latissimus dorsi and middle/lower trapezius (upper and mid back)
new-016.secondary: posterior deltoid (rear shoulder) and teres major

gap-n030.name: Pilates Swan (prone back extension)

gap-n030.p1: lying flat face down on the mat, arms extended straight forward on the mat beyond her head, legs straight
gap-n030.p2: chest, arms and both straight legs lifted off the mat at the same time into a gentle prone backbend, arms extended forward, only the hips and lower belly touching the mat
gap-n030.primary: erector spinae (the long muscles running up both sides of the spine on the back)
gap-n030.extra: She is the same woman as the reference: keep her feminine body shape visible from the side.

gap-n009.name: Carioca (grapevine lateral run)
gap-n009.setup: bodyweight running drill moving sideways across the frame to the viewer's right, light athletic stance on the balls of the feet, arms bent and held out for balance; the camera sees her from the front at a mild three-quarter angle
gap-n009.p1: CROSS IN FRONT: her trailing leg swings across IN FRONT of her lead leg (the crossing knee is nearer the camera than the other leg), hips twisted toward the direction of travel while her chest still faces the camera
gap-n009.p2: CROSS BEHIND: the same trailing leg now steps BEHIND her lead leg (the crossing leg is further from the camera and partly hidden behind the other leg), hips twisted the opposite way, chest still facing the camera
gap-n009.primary: hip adductors and abductors (inner and outer thighs) and obliques (sides of the waist)
gap-n009.extra: Make the difference unmistakable: in panel 1 the crossing leg is clearly in front, in panel 2 clearly behind.

gap-y007.name: Downward Dog (yoga)
gap-y007.setup: bodyweight on a dark grey yoga mat
gap-y007.p1: tabletop on hands and knees: hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat
gap-y007.p2: Downward Dog: knees lifted, hips pushed high up and back so the body forms an inverted V, arms and legs straight, heels reaching toward the mat, head between the upper arms
gap-y007.primary: deltoids (shoulders) and hamstrings (back of thighs, being stretched)
gap-y007.secondary: calves (gastrocnemius and soleus, stretched) and abdominals

new-p3-006.name: Foam Roll Calves

new-p3-006.p1: hips and buttocks resting DOWN on the mat, legs relaxed on the roller

new-036.p2: advanced tuck front lever, seen exactly SIDE-ON: arms straight from the bar angled down to the shoulders, and her torso held like a flat coffee-table top directly under the bar - shoulders, back and hips all on one HORIZONTAL line parallel to the floor, her face looking up at the ceiling, hips NOT below the shoulders and NOT tipped upside down, thighs pulled in so the knees are near the chest and the shins hang down
new-036.primary: latissimus dorsi (sides of the upper back)

new-011.name: Standing Broad Jump

new-011.secondary: hamstrings (back of thighs) and hip flexors (front of hips)

new-023.name: Pilates Criss Cross

gap-y009.name: Eagle Arms (yoga)
gap-y009.setup: standing tall on a dark grey yoga mat
gap-y009.p1: both arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height
gap-y009.p2: arms wrapped: right elbow tucked under the left elbow, forearms crossed and twisted so the palms press together in front of the face, elbows lifted to shoulder height, upper back rounded wide
gap-y009.primary: rhomboids and middle trapezius (between the shoulder blades, being stretched)
gap-y009.extra: Turn the camera to a mild three-quarter view from slightly behind her side so her upper back and her arms are both visible.

new-p3-004.name: Extended Side Angle (yoga)
new-p3-004.setup: wide stance on a dark grey yoga mat, right foot pointing forward, left back foot turned in slightly, left leg straight
new-p3-004.p1: Warrior 2: right front knee bent 90 degrees over the ankle, arms extended out to the sides parallel to the floor, torso upright
new-p3-004.p2: Extended Side Angle: right forearm resting on the right thigh, torso tilted over the bent right leg, left arm reaching up and over the ear in one long diagonal line from the left heel to the left fingertips, chest open to the side
new-p3-004.primary: obliques (side of the waist) and gluteus medius of the bent right leg
new-p3-004.secondary: adductors of the straight left leg (inner thigh) and quadriceps
new-p3-004.extra: Turn the camera so she faces the viewer at a mild three-quarter angle so the side bend is clearly visible.

new-039.name: Garland Squat (Malasana)
new-039.setup: on a dark grey yoga mat, feet wider than hips with toes turned out
new-039.p1: standing tall, hands pressed together in prayer at the chest
new-039.p2: deep wide squat with hips low just above the mat, heels down, hands in prayer at the chest and the elbows pressing against the inner knees
new-039.primary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and gluteus maximus (buttocks)
new-039.secondary: adductor magnus (inner thighs) and soleus (lower calves)

new-045.name: Half-kneeling Overhead Hold
new-045.setup: half-kneeling on a mat: left knee on the mat, right foot flat in front, torso tall, a light dumbbell in the left hand
new-045.p1: dumbbell held racked at the left shoulder, elbow bent
new-045.p2: dumbbell locked out overhead with the left arm fully straight, held still, torso braced and upright
new-045.primary: upper trapezius (top of the shoulder and neck) and forearm flexors (grip)

new-048.name: Incline Cable Fly
new-048.setup: lying on an incline bench (about 30 degrees) placed between two cable towers, holding a D-handle in each hand attached to the LOW pulleys, cables visible running to the pulleys
new-048.p1: arms opened wide out to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows, handles at chest level, chest stretched
new-048.p2: handles brought together in a wide arc to meet above the upper chest, arms extended
new-048.secondary: upper chest near the collarbone and anterior deltoid (front shoulder)

new-p3-007.name: Knee to Chest Stretch
new-p3-007.setup: lying on her back on a dark grey mat
new-p3-007.p1: lying flat with both legs straight on the mat and arms by her sides
new-p3-007.p2: right knee pulled in to the chest with both hands clasped around the right shin, left leg straight on the mat
new-p3-007.primary: lower back (erector spinae) and gluteus maximus of the right leg (being stretched)
new-p3-007.secondary: hamstrings and the hip flexors of the straight left leg
new-p3-007.extra: Keep her torso visible with her feminine chest and waist through the blue top.

new-055.name: Landmine Rotational Press
new-055.setup: a barbell with one end anchored in a landmine base on the floor and a weight plate on the other end; he stands facing the loaded end in an athletic stance, holding the end of the barbell sleeve with both hands
new-055.p1: bar end held at the right shoulder, torso and hips rotated to the right
new-055.p2: hips and torso rotated forward to face left of centre, right heel pivoted, bar pressed up and out diagonally to full arm extension

new-061.name: Lying Leg Raises
new-061.setup: lying on her back on a dark grey mat, arms by her sides palms down
new-061.p1: both legs straight together, heels just above the mat
new-061.p2: both legs raised straight up together to vertical, 90 degrees to the floor, lower back on the mat
new-061.primary: iliopsoas (hip flexors, front of the hips)
new-061.extra: Keep her torso visible with her feminine chest and waist through the blue top.

new-067.name: Overhead Reverse Lunge
new-067.setup: standing, a dumbbell held locked out overhead in the right hand with the arm straight
new-067.p1: standing tall, feet together, dumbbell overhead
new-067.p2: left leg stepped back into a reverse lunge, back knee just above the floor, front thigh parallel to the floor, torso upright, dumbbell still locked out overhead
new-067.primary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and gluteus maximus (buttocks)

new-072.name: Plank Up-downs
new-072.setup: on a dark grey mat in plank, feet on the toes
new-072.p1: forearm plank: both forearms on the mat, elbows under shoulders, body straight from heels to head
new-072.p2: pushed up to a straight-arm plank: both hands flat under the shoulders, arms straight, body still straight from heels to head - clearly higher than panel 1
new-072.extra: Keep her feminine chest and waist visible from the side through the blue top.

new-076.name: Pseudo-planche Push-up
new-076.setup: push-up position on the floor with the hands placed back beside the waist, fingers turned out to the sides, body leaning forward so the shoulders are well in front of the hands
new-076.p1: top position: arms straight, shoulders far forward past the hands, body straight from heels to head
new-076.p2: bottom position: elbows bent tight to the body pointing back, chest lowered just above the floor, shoulders still forward of the hands
new-076.primary: pectoralis major (chest) and serratus anterior (side of the ribs)

new-078.name: Reverse Hyperextension
new-078.setup: lying face down on a reverse hyper machine: torso on the top pad with the hips at the back edge, hands gripping the front handles, ankles in the strap of the swinging pendulum
new-078.p1: legs hanging straight down below the pad
new-078.p2: straight legs swung up behind him until they are horizontal, in line with the torso
new-078.primary: gluteus maximus (buttocks) and erector spinae (lower back)

gap-y021.name: Revolved Triangle (yoga)
gap-y021.setup: wide staggered stance on a dark grey yoga mat, right foot forward, both legs straight
gap-y021.p1: standing upright in the stance, arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height
gap-y021.p2: torso folded forward and rotated to the right: left hand on the mat outside the right foot, right arm reaching straight up to the ceiling, both legs straight

new-083.name: Pilates Roll Over
new-083.setup: lying on her back on a dark grey mat, arms long by her sides palms down
new-083.p1: both legs straight and together raised to vertical
new-083.p2: legs swept up and over the head so they are parallel to the floor behind her head, hips and spine peeled off the mat, weight on the shoulder blades
new-083.extra: Keep her torso visible with her feminine chest and waist through the blue top.

gap-n026.name: Pilates Rolling Like a Ball
gap-n026.setup: on a dark grey mat, body in a tight tuck: knees pulled to the chest, hands holding the shins, head curled down
gap-n026.p1: balanced on the sit-bones in the tuck, feet just off the mat
gap-n026.p2: rolled backward onto the upper back between the shoulder blades, still in the same tight tuck, hips lifted, feet above the head height of panel 1

new-119.name: T-bar Row (landmine)
new-119.setup: a barbell anchored at one end in a landmine base, weight plates on the other end, a V-grip row handle hooked under the bar just behind the plates; he straddles the bar, hips hinged so the torso is about 45 degrees, back flat
new-119.p1: arms straight, plates hanging just above the floor
new-119.p2: handle pulled up to the lower chest, elbows driven back past the torso, torso angle unchanged
new-119.primary: latissimus dorsi and middle/lower trapezius (upper and mid back)

new-005.name: Side-lying Band Leg Press
new-005.setup: lying on his left side on a mat, head resting on the left arm, a long resistance band looped around the sole of the top (right) foot with both ends held in the right hand at the chest
new-005.p1: top right knee bent and drawn in toward the chest, band slack-to-taut
new-005.p2: top right leg pressed straight out in line with the body against the stretched band
new-005.primary: quadriceps (front of thigh) and gluteus maximus (buttock) of the top leg

new-095.name: Single-arm Dumbbell Kickback (kneeling on a bench)
new-095.setup: left knee and left hand on a flat bench, back flat and parallel to the floor, right foot on the floor, dumbbell in the right hand, right upper arm held tight to the side and parallel to the floor
new-095.p1: right elbow bent 90 degrees, forearm hanging straight down
new-095.p2: right forearm extended straight back so the whole arm is straight and parallel to the floor
new-095.primary: triceps brachii (back of the upper arm)

gap-y006.name: Sphinx Pose (yoga)
gap-y006.setup: lying face down on a dark grey yoga mat, legs straight
gap-y006.p1: lying flat with forehead resting on the stacked hands
gap-y006.p2: propped up on the forearms with elbows directly under the shoulders, forearms flat on the mat, chest lifted into a gentle backbend, hips on the mat

new-103.name: Squat Swings
new-103.setup: bodyweight on the floor, feet shoulder-width
new-103.p1: standing tall with both arms swung up forward to shoulder height
new-103.p2: deep squat, thighs parallel, heels flat, both arms swung down and back behind the hips
new-103.primary: quadriceps (front of thighs) and gluteus maximus (buttocks)

new-110.name: Standing Figure-4 Glute Stretch
new-110.setup: standing in front of a waist-height metal rail, holding it with both hands for balance
new-110.p1: standing on the left leg, right ankle crossed over the left knee
new-110.p2: sitting the hips back and down as if into a chair on the left leg, torso leaning forward, right shin now near horizontal across the left thigh
new-110.primary: piriformis and deep hip rotators (deep buttock of the right, crossed leg, being stretched)
new-110.secondary: gluteus maximus of the right leg

new-121.name: Pilates Teaser Prep (one leg)
new-121.p1: lying on her back, left knee bent with the left foot flat on the mat, right leg straight and lifted to match the angle of the left thigh, arms reaching overhead
new-121.p2: rolled up partway: torso lifted about 60 degrees off the mat, arms reaching forward parallel to the lifted right leg, left foot still on the mat
new-121.extra: Keep her torso visible with her feminine chest and waist through the blue top.

gap-n020.name: Toy Soldier (walking straight-leg kicks)
gap-n020.setup: walking forward on the floor, standing tall
gap-n020.p1: right leg kicked straight forward to hip height with the knee straight, left arm reaching forward toward the right toes, right arm swung back
gap-n020.p2: left leg kicked straight forward to hip height, right arm reaching forward toward the left toes, left arm swung back
gap-n020.primary: hamstrings of the kicking leg (being stretched)

new-126.name: Waiter Carry (dumbbell)
new-126.setup: a single dumbbell held overhead in the right hand with the arm locked straight, the dumbbell resting on the flat open palm like a waiter's tray
new-126.p1: standing still with feet together, dumbbell overhead
new-126.p2: walking forward mid-stride, left leg forward, dumbbell still overhead on the open palm, arm straight

gap-y026.name: Warrior 3 (yoga)
gap-y026.setup: on a dark grey yoga mat
gap-y026.p1: standing tall on the left leg with the right toes lightly touching the mat behind, arms raised overhead
gap-y026.p2: hinged forward into a T-shape: torso and straight arms parallel to the floor reaching forward, right leg lifted straight back in line with the torso, left standing leg straight
gap-y026.primary: gluteus maximus/medius and hamstrings of the left standing leg

defect-barbell-shrug.name: Barbell Shrug
defect-barbell-shrug.setup: standing tall holding a loaded barbell at arm's length in front of the thighs, overhand grip just outside the hips, arms straight in both panels
defect-barbell-shrug.p1: shoulders fully relaxed and dropped LOW, long neck visible between shoulders and ears
defect-barbell-shrug.p2: shoulders shrugged straight up toward the ears as HIGH as possible - EXAGGERATE this: the tops of the shoulders almost touch the earlobes, the neck almost hidden, and the barbell visibly higher on the thighs than in panel 1
defect-barbell-shrug.primary: upper trapezius (top of the shoulders and neck)
defect-barbell-shrug.extra: Turn the camera so he faces the viewer at a mild three-quarter angle so the shoulder height change is obvious.
